market_name: Will 8 Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether the implied-probability jump coincides with a macro headline (weak jobs/CPI, financial stress) or is idiosyncratic thin-market noise; confirm 2y/10y yields ticking lower.
time_plan.1h: Compare move against fed funds futures (CME FedWatch) — genuine repricing should show up there too; if futures are flat, treat as noise.
time_plan.2h: Reassess TLT vs benchmark; look for confirmation from rate-sensitive equities (utilities, homebuilders) and credit spreads.
time_plan.6h: Check for any Fed speaker commentary or data revisions; evaluate whether the move is holding or fading.
time_plan.12h: Final read: did Treasuries hold the bid? Log whether the prediction-market signal led, coincided, or reversed relative to public rate markets.

predictions.reasoning: A market pricing 8 Fed cuts (200bps) in 2026 implies a dramatically dovish/recessionary path far beyond current consensus (~1-3 cuts). A sharp rise in this probability would reflect expectations of aggressive easing, which pushes front-end and long-end yields lower and bond prices higher. TLT is the cleanest liquid proxy for a large downward shift in the expected rate path.

predictions.tradable_instrument_name: Invesco DB US Dollar Index Bullish Fund

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Verify whether DXY is moving in tandem with the rate repricing or diverging due to risk-off dollar demand.
time_plan.1h: Check EUR/USD and JPY moves to see if this is a broad dollar story or a rate-differential story.
time_plan.2h: Reassess whether risk-off (equities down) is overriding the rate-differential channel and supporting the dollar instead.
time_plan.6h: Look for confirmation from front-end rate spreads vs G10 peers.
time_plan.12h: Final read: net dollar direction and whether the prediction-market move had any leading value.

predictions.reasoning: An 8-cut easing scenario would narrow US rate differentials versus other major central banks, typically weakening the dollar. UUP would fall as easing expectations deepen. However, the linkage is weaker: aggressive-easing/recession scenarios can also trigger safe-haven dollar demand, muddying the sign.

evidence_used: Market question implies 8 x 25bps = 200bps of easing in 2026, far above typical consensus
Rate-path repricing transmits to Treasury yields, the dollar, and gold via well-known channels
FedWatch/fed funds futures serve as a public benchmark for validating any signal
uncertainty_notes: 8 cuts is a deep tail scenario; small probability changes carry little information unless dramatic
Prediction-market liquidity on this specific strike is likely thin, so implied-probability moves may be noise
Recession-driven easing can produce conflicting signals: bonds up but dollar could rise on safe-haven flows
Fed policy is heavily telegraphed and priced by liquid rates markets, so leakage/edge is unlikely

llm_justification.summary: The market prices an extreme dovish outcome (200bps of 2026 cuts). A sharp increase in its implied probability would signal expectations of aggressive Fed easing, most cleanly mapping to higher long-duration Treasury prices (TLT up) and secondarily a weaker dollar (UUP down). Both linkages are directionally sensible but low-conviction: the scenario is a tail, the market is likely thin, and public rate markets already price the Fed path efficiently. Neither implication approaches the 700bps tradable threshold in a 12h window.
key_assumptions: A probability jump reflects genuine repricing of the Fed path, not thin-market noise
Standard rate-transmission channels hold (lower expected rates => higher bond prices, weaker USD)
No overriding safe-haven flow reverses the dollar sign
failure_modes: The move is thin-market noise with no counterpart in fed funds futures or Treasury yields
Information is already public (data/Fed guidance) so assets have already moved — no leakage edge
Recession-risk interpretation drives safe-haven dollar buying, flipping the UUP call
Expected magnitudes are far below the 700bps tradable bar, so any signal is non-actionable
Proxy exposure is diffuse; TLT/UUP also respond to many unrelated macro factors
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
